The oracle is independent of the package: the tree kernel is hand-built from a bit-mismatch recursion (not the package helper) and is checked equal to the package-derived covariance to 1e-10. A base-R dense Laplace marginal (nlminb with analytic score and Hessian, finite-difference checked) is evaluated at the fitted parameters and must match logLik to 1e-4. The one mismatch is R/julia-bridge.R, which HEAD 7fd8acec3 changed after e9c72ab3e in NB2-only Julia selector hunks, not on this native Beta path.
